# ESARC

> ESARC is a Canadian AI engineering consultancy run by Vaibhav Malhotra. Senior engineers paired with an in-house fleet of AI coding agents, shipping production AI systems for US and Canadian companies that want senior accountability without a Big-4 invoice.

ESARC takes a small number of engagements per year. Every line that ships is reviewed by a principal engineer. The agent fleet drafts, tests, and reviews under that direction. Output is measured in PRs, evals, and dashboards, not slide decks. ESARC bills US clients in USD from a Canadian cost base, with SR&ED-backed R&D where the work qualifies.

## Engagement shapes

- [AI Diagnostic Sprint](https://esarc.dev/services#diagnostic-sprint): Two-week written assessment, prioritized roadmap, exec readout. Pick when you need clarity before you commit.
- [Build Sprint](https://esarc.dev/services#build-sprint): Six-week build of one AI surface. LLM feature, voice agent, eval harness, RAG system. Pick when scope is clear.
- [Embedded AI Team](https://esarc.dev/services#embedded-team): Three to six month embedded team. Principal plus agent fleet inside your repo and Slack. Pick when AI is a roadmap, not a feature.

## Canada wedge for US buyers

- [Canada for US buyers](https://esarc.dev/canada): How a Canadian AI team serves US enterprises. CAD cost base with USD invoicing, SR&ED-backed R&D at up to 35%, Vector Institute and Waterloo talent, EST and PT timezone coverage, Canadian data residency tailwinds.

## Case studies

- [Meta Superintelligence Labs](https://esarc.dev/work/meta-superintelligence): Applied AI engineering inside Meta's Superintelligence Labs. Tool-calling, MCP integration, agent evaluation for next-gen conversational AI.
- [Amazon](https://esarc.dev/work/amazon-shipping-ai): SDE work on Amazon's shipping cost pipeline. 1M+ requests per day, $100K+ annualized savings, 50% latency cut on cart building.
- [Scrubs Co-Pilot](https://esarc.dev/work/scrubs-co-pilot): Clinical documentation co-pilot. Whisper transcription plus LLM+RAG pipeline producing structured doctor notes a clinician signs off on.
- [Stuf Storage — Sidney Voice AI](https://esarc.dev/work/stuf-sidney-ai): Voice AI for self-storage operations. 150+ qualified leads at ISS Vegas, +25% demo success, -60% fallback prompts.
- [MyMethod](https://esarc.dev/work/mymethod): Multi-tenant voice AI agents on Vapi with the eval and observability work to keep quality from drifting between releases.
- [Springhouse](https://esarc.dev/work/springhouse): Multi-agent food planning backend on Pydantic AI, FastAPI, and Postgres. Recipe ingest, calorie math, household constraints.
- [McGraw Hill](https://esarc.dev/work/mcgraw-hill): Senior AI engineering consulting for an education publisher. Scope details under NDA.
- [ClearProp](https://esarc.dev/work/clearprop): A full-stack pilot logbook app built as an own product. ESARC's internal proving ground for new patterns before they show up on client work.

## About

- [About ESARC](https://esarc.dev/about): Vaibhav Malhotra. 9 years engineering at Amazon, Scrubs Co-Pilot, Stuf Storage, and now Meta Superintelligence Labs. Why one principal plus a fleet of agents ships what a team of six used to ship.

## Process

- [How an engagement runs](https://esarc.dev/process): Five phases, discovery, scope, sprint, ship, handoff. Daily PRs, written deliverables, no Friday surprises.

## Contact

- [Contact ESARC](https://esarc.dev/contact): Tell us what you are trying to ship, or grab a 30-minute intro on the calendar. Same-day reply on weekdays.
